scope.implemented: A development-only canonical JSON authorization declaration, deterministic obligation compiler, information-equivalent B/D renderers, exact fixed-context input loader, zero-executable-tool model host, result validator, complete attempt telemetry, hash-bound semantic review, offline evaluator, and resumable development runner.
excluded: target project execution or live deployment probing

completePairObservation.interpretation: This one complete pair favors D but is insufficient to establish a general method advantage.

revisionComparison.change: Both arms now list exact runnable expanded obligation IDs as a closed result-contract set and forbid authored, omitted, or foreign IDs.
revisionComparison.targetedDefectResult: Both arms' first schema responses used the correct expanded obligation ID; the foreign/missing-obligation defect was removed.

unitOutcomes.note: The schema response used the exact ID but had a different invalid shape; fallback completion remained unknown.
Eight citation-text mismatches triggered the one allowed repair.

revisionComparison.interpretation: The interface defect is fixed, but paired task-quality impact is unmeasured because B timed out; the revision is not combined with the initial denominator.

evidence: The same declaration compiles and renders both arms without case-specific code.
Exact source, output validation, semantic review, repair accounting, resume behavior, and offline replay are operational.
One initial pair completed and favored D, while two initial pairs and the revision pair were incomplete due timeout-unknown calls.
Completed answers frequently required repair for output IDs or citation fidelity; trusted-header D retained two critical semantic omissions.

unresolvedIssues: Schema-tool and prompt-fallback outputs do not yet share a sufficiently reliable narrow shape; one revision B schema result mixed an object and a string and omitted a required array.
Exact quotation and crop-line citations are a dominant repair trigger even when the semantic trace is correct.
Three provider calls have unknown completion, usage, and cost after the host cutoff; no retries were issued.
Actual USD cost is unavailable for all eighteen calls.
The trusted-header result did not fully state the authentication failure branch or all four conditional deployment outcomes.
Only one project/ref and one complete B/D pair were observed; no cross-project or repository-discovery claim is supported.

minimumImplementation: Use one narrower schema shape across schema-tool and fallback paths, making observations conditional on unknown rather than boilerplate for decisive conclusions.
Replace model-guessed crop line/quote pairs with a citation representation that the host can map and verify deterministically against numbered fixed context.
Re-run only the existing fixed-context development cases until no-repair completion and completion-known rates are measurable; do not add entry discovery or a second project first.
successCriteria: Both arms parse without fallback-shape divergence.
Correct semantic answers do not require citation-only repair.
A complete B/D pair is obtained without retrying completion-unknown calls.
